rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-snipset/2026-09-26 - c7-cold-start-window-title [ses_f20d57d7effeNHGT3VJjjKVw1X].md:L4772] "**Information loss, stated honestly.** Collapsing 10 titles into 1 does lose real information: after the change a screen reader enumerating windows sees ten windows all named "Snipset Magic Menu". Today it can at least tell `notes-menu` from `clipboard-menu` by title. The loss is bounded, though, because (a) each window keeps a distinct Tauri `label` (`magic-menu`, `clipboard-menu`, …) which is what the frontend and the a11y layer actually key on, and (b) these windows are `decorations(false)` + `visible(false)` + `skip_taskbar(true)`, so the only audience is a screen-reader user deliberately browsing the window list, who then sees each overlay's own localised content. I judge that acceptable and I implemented the approved single-key approach. If the parent disagrees, the alternative is 10 `NativeKey` variants and a `MenuOverlayKind -> NativeKey` match next to the existing `overlay_spec` match; that is ~30 more lines and buys only the title-level distinction above. I found no correctness problem, so per the contract I did not stop on this."
